points.description: States the property: a spanning tree has a single unique path between every pair of nodes (loop-free subnet containing all nodes), so no unnecessary duplicates are forwarded. Equivalent wording accepted.

Explains the modification of link state routing: add multicast group membership information to the link state packets, so once topology and group info are flooded, each node has full information and can locally compute the multicast spanning tree (e.g. with Prim or Kruskal; algorithm names optional).
